notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=k6i9ZYdc1Rg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]View the DLC store page here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390840/Spookys_Jump_Scare_Mansion__The_Doll_House/]LINK

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1390840/ss_8b47f5c07531835829029af148da9062ed5a4e36.600x338.jpg[/img][/url][/b]

Spooky's Doll House is a new DLC for this version of Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion, and it's also coming to the HD release of SJSM as a free content update. It will continue where Karamari Hospital left off, finish the story line, and introduce new monsters.

The DLC version is made on the original engine that SJSM used, and the HD release is made to follow it as closely as possible.

I tried my hardest to make the DLC version as good as I could and push the limits of the engine and the AMG team are trying their hardest to remake it faithfully in the HD version and utilize the extra features of their engine.

We are also updating the base game with some player movement fixes, and credit adjustments.

[i]Thanks for all the support over the years, I'm eagerly looking forward to the release![/i]

notes.title: Spooky's HD March 1st Launch and Why
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'd like to start this post off by saying THANK YOU. Thank you so everyone who put the game on their wishlists and THANK YOU to everyone who has been patient with us as we finish up this project. We've had to push release a few times and we know it can be a bit frustrating because you all want the game now but trust us, it'll be worth it.

Onto some explinations and updates

We finished off all the scripted rooms and specimen for each set of rooms. Why this took so much time is because each specimen now has a way they "spawn" into the room. They don't just... poof into existance like they did in the original game. They all have special animations for entering rooms and chases now. For example, specimen 2 spawns out of the goop puddles and you can see him do this. Specimen 3 actually crawls out of holes in the ceiling, etc. I don't want to spoil too much of course.

We are currently working on improving the arcade games that you find on the occasion. They'll still be Mall of the Spook, Mrs. Spook, and Spooky Cart, but they'll be a little different and work better all together.

The "Brain Room" - room thas has the tank with the brain inside now does something special - we can't say what yet. It's a cool surprise.

CAT-DOS is also being worked on, it'll have a cool new system to it that I think you all will enjoy.

That's just a few things that we've been working on this week that have caused us to push the game back just a few more days.

We could technically release right now but CAT-DOS, arcade games, brain room and a few small things wouldn't be included and we feel that's not acceptable. 

We want to release the game with all content and not have to patch things in, I know some of you want the game now but please hold off with us for a few more days. 

Anyway, thanks for reading and keeping up with us, we appreciate it. 

-The Albino Moose Games team

Please make sure you put [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/577690/]Spooky's HD[/url] on your Wishlist! The game will cost 10 dollars USD and a 33% discount on launch!

notes.title: Dev Blog 2/17/2017
notes.notes:
Dangit we didn't launch! I assure you we tried really hard but it just wasn't in the cards, there was too much left to do, but here's what did happen - 

Last Saturday (2/11) Sheena mapped out all of Spec 6's area and added the shadow students to all the school rooms, I had to do a number of fixes for Spec 5 + I did a lot of tuning & refinement on Spec 6 - he no longer will be positioned in walls when he teleports and he has an animation when he vanishes from you looking at him too long, which is really unnerving. I finished all of Spec 5's section and then after Sheena's stuff was checked in I got Spec 6's section finished up too - and then started a bit on 7's area. It was an incredibly productive day. 

Sunday I finished up 7's area which had a lot of weird little details to it, and added the fancy new studio splash video that MowtenDoo made & A_Rival made a little jingle for. It looks and sounds incredibly good. Sheena imported materials and laid out the all the mid rooms & fixed the lighting control on the school section so you always have your trusty flashlight. I also fixed a bizarre bug where you could have two rooms loaded at the same time - definitely one that needed to be done.

On Monday Sheena finishd all the mid rooms layout and started laying out the rare-series of rooms. We were really focused on main series stuff and actually completely spaced the rare rooms. I did scripts for the mid rooms and integrated all the VO and subtitles for them - plus made a mess of meshes and bugfixes.

Tuesday was Sheena putting finishing touches on the School section and getting all the rare rooms mapped out and their materials set up. I did a lot of sprint tuning and prep work for the woods - I made some cool foliage tech for the gras in that section.

Wednesday for me was a bunch of Spec 3 fixes - he had a bad habit of sometimes not spawning properly and would just sit in the other room in the Lab trying to walk through doors he can't traverse. It was goofy.  I also got the scripts written for even more rare rooms. Sheena greyboxed out all the woods area - literally put grey boxes where things that needed models created or had special scripts (like the record player needs scripts and the shelves need meshes). Later on Wednesday I finished up my grass generation tech and started getting the outdoor areas working.

Thursday Sheena got sick and was KO'd for most of the day, but she still got a good chunk of Spec 10's area greyboxed out. I made the scripts responsible for the gif that's below this post, fixed a bunch of bugs, and got the axe and the scary deer in the game. The axe looks a little wonky, but I'm pretty proud of it and it fits.

Which brings us to today! Sheena finished the Spec 10 greybox plus got a lot done on the Food area and I finished the first pass (still missing a few sfx) on the Woods area - but all the scripts are in and you can fully play through it. I had to throw together and texture a bunch of meshes for it but the result is real nice, at least I think. So tomorrow I launch in to implementing the Spec 10 area, or fixing some VR stuff, we'll see - and Sheena is gonna keep mapping out and detailing the Food area and then on to the mansion within a mansion!

See you next week for release!

P.S: If you haven't already, go throw the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/577690/]HD remake[/url] on your Wishlist! 

P.P.S: The game will cost 10 dollars USD with a launch discount of 33%!

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/ac9f2d86880724cb4e44e4ce62191faa.gif[/img]

notes.title: Spooky's HD New Release: Feb 24th and Why
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm sure you noticed the release date has changed to one week later. Releasing Feb 24th. I'm here to give you a quck explination as to why.

With this new remake, we were excited to add more to Spooky's, with a new, stronger game engine (Unity), we could do so much. Well, we decided to do just that. When we decided on Feb 17th as the release date, that was more or less us throwing a dart at a board and trying to finish then. 

Clearly that didn't go so well. There's still some fun unfinished things like new minigames, a better CAT-DOS, 3D models and animations, more special variations of rooms, and some fun secret stuff.

We would rather have everything finished and polished, vs throwing together some unfinished thing and calling it shipped and updating later.

So we decided to instead, push the date back a week and get everything in at the release date. 

Sorry we pushed the release date a week but we would rather do that and feel better about it than release an almost finished game. 

Thank you for your patience and you won't regret waiting an extra week!

-Albino Moose Games Team

notes.title: Steam Greenlight
notes.notes:
Hello fleshlings! 

We've started the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=811437403]Greenlight[/url] process for Spooky's HD Renovation and would love your support!

There's also some certifiably fresh screenshots on the page and all the updates to this game too! Come check it out and give us a vote!

Thank you from Psychobilly and the Albino Moose Games team

WHY THIS IS A NEW GAME:

As you might know the original Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion was written in GameMaker 8 - which only has the most rudimentary of 3D support. In order to add features like 3D specimens, VR, Mac & Linux ports, and to fix a lot of the nagging issues (like getting stuck on corners) and other much-requested features it has to be rewritten from the ground up! We're taking this opportunity to add all that and more in Unity - which is a modern fully featured natively 3D engine that is a lot easier to work with for this kind of game than old GameMaker.

notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I would like to happily announce that Spooky's is being remade in the Unity engine. Here's what that means in a sweet bullet point style because I love bullet points.

[list]
    [*]Updated graphics
    [*]3D models will now replace the old 2D specimen models
    [*]Full controller support for various controllers
    [*]Mac, Linux, and Windows ports because Unity allows for that
    [*]Options like screen resolution, volume control, invert mouse, mouse sensitivity etc
    [*]More minigames
    [*]A few new specimen for Endless mode
    [*]Allowing multiple specimen to appear at once during chases
    [*]More cool music
    [*]More easter eggs
    [*]VR support for Oculus Rift and Vive
    [*]Ability to flip between old and new specimens models in-game at any point with the press of a button.
    [*]Steam Trading Cards, Emotes and Steam Backgrounds - You guys have been asking, now it's time.
[/list]

Spooky's is just being REMADE in a different engine which means the story and all the specimen encounters are all still the same like the original game but will have 3D models, run more smoothly upon play, you won't get stuck on corners or doors anymore. Cool things like that. This new port will also be packaged with the DLC automatically and will cost about 5 to 10 dollars due to packaging the DLC AND VR support.

We are NOT removing the original Spooky's off the Steam store, IndieDB or anywhere else. This will be it's own product for those who wish to have it. If you don't like the price, you can continue to play the original game because it won't be taken down.

This game is set to release for Christmas of this year. (2016)

This new port will solve a lot of major issues that Spooky's has including collision issues, controller support issues, Steam overlay and Steam streaming issues, graphical issues and performance issues. 

Get hype!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q4s1s6q.png[/img]

Here's a teaser, Old Specimen 2 on the left, New Specimen 2 on the right.

notes.title: Spooky's Name Change and Why This Happened
notes.notes:
Hello Fleshlings,

Psychobilly2422 here, you might’ve noticed a few updates recently, and we here at Lag Studios owe you an explanation. What happened is around July of last year we received a cease & desist for using the name “Spooky’s House of Jump Scares” because a company called “Spooky House Studios” is trying to get the trademark for “Spooky House”. They are mobile developers based in Germany and already have the trademark in the European Union, and demanded we change our name. 

When this happened we started working with the most excellent lawyer Ryan Morrison who was very sympathetic to our plight. He showed us our options and helped understand associated risks, but unfortunately, being a staff of two who released a free game, we didn’t really have the means to deal with an international legal battle. While the terms of our settlement are confidential, and I have been advised by Ryan to not share anything further, our game will now be titled Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion. We are currently propagating new builds and new branding out everywhere, and thank you for bearing with us through all of this!

Sincerely,
The Lag Studios Team

They are mobile developers based in Germany and already have the trademark in the European Union, and demanded we change our name. 

When this happened we started working with the most excellent lawyer Ryan Morrison who was very sympathetic to our plight. He showed us our options and helped understand associated risks, but unfortunately, being a staff of two who released a free game, we didn’t really have the means to deal with an international legal battle. While the terms of our settlement are confidential, and I have been advised by Ryan to not share anything further, our game will now be titled Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion. We are currently propagating new builds and new branding out everywhere, and thank you for bearing with us through all of this!

Sincerely,
The Lag Studios Team

notes.title: Major Game Breaking Bug Known and Being Fixed (Feb 16, 2016)
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone,

Akuma Kira and I have read your posts on the Steam forums and we are so sorry for this major game breaking bug with the recent update.

What this update contained was controller support and a more updated and clean save system that we created for the DLC and decided to impliment into the base game. Why a new save system you ask? Well, in previous updates for the game, if we added anything to the game and updated it here on Steam, your save would corrupt after every update. We've found a solution to this issue that allows us to update the game and keep your save.

However, something went wrong with our new save system that we are currently looking into fixing ASAP. 

As a quick fix, we have reverted back to a previous build of the game until we can solve this issue.

Now I will give you instructions on how to jump to room 250, 500, or 750.

On the main menu, navigate to the bottom right hand corner where you see a "Settings" button. Once you're in the Settings menu, navigate to the desired room number and type in the password as presented. Yes, this is case sensitive.

Room 250: PUMPKIN

Room 500: CHEESE

Room 750: CAKE

notes.title: DLC Release Date and Trailer
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 3 - 7/21/2015
notes.notes:
Congratulations, we've made it this far. Hello, Spooky here.

Welcome to the official finished release of my home, Spooky's House of Jump Scares. I've very happy to have more fleshy live ones in my home.

What's new you ask? WELL! You are now welcome to survive all 1000 rooms of my home! That's right, all 1000 rooms! I've added some new Specimen to greet you.

I've also added some nice scenery for your human eyes to see.

I've "balanced" the gameplay more as Psychobilly and Akuma Kira put it. I guess they thought some specimen were to easy and too hard so we fixed some of them.

We've also found some bugs, no, not Specimen 3. Actual bugs! How neat! We optimized the House better, fixed some spooky sounds to stop the crackling and added some nice new sounds as well!

There's 2 endings that you can recieve depending on how you behave in my home. Let's see what you get!

I think that's it! Let's see if you make it you fleshy... live ones... He he he

[b]Please Note[/b]:
Your previous save will not work due to an issue with major updates and old save files.You'll need to start a new save file and you will need to use the level skip option in the main menu options and the passwords we provided for you throughout the game to skip ahead. Your new save will function with this build.

notes.title: Update 2 - 5/8/2015
notes.notes:
Hey there you fleshy live ones, Spooky here.

Today we have a small update in my home. Today's update optimizes the audio in game and now all of the audio loads in externally instead of internally. We had a long battle with the U.S.S Snap-Crackle-Pop on the Steam forums but we have come to an agreement to fix the audio as soon as possible and now everyone is happy.

We also fixed the game resolution issue that some people were having. No, you can't change from various resolutions, but there is a small setting for visuals in the settings located at the bottom right hand corner.

When you encounter Specimen 10 for the first time, the exit door has been moved to a different location so that you're forced to look at Specimen 10.

Materials also load in externally instead of internally.

Thanks for your patience as we build my home to fit everyone and everything inside of it. Come be my next [strike] victim[/strike] guest.
